description: Grow PM host hooks (since v2.6.0). SessionStart: a context digest so every skill knows where local-context.md is (or that it is not visible from this environment). PreToolUse: a human-in-the-loop confirmation before creating/updating Jira issues and Confluence pages, under the Atlassian MCP v1 and v2 tool names — the artifact quality gate report must be in the chat before this prompt appears; since v3.10.0 also before a file write under a shared-context provider's read-only folder (references/context-provider-protocol.md §7); since v4.0.0 also before a Write/Edit/MultiEdit that changes a generated region of a vault note (references/vault-schema.md, Generated regions). Both fail open: any script error allows the action.
